title: EzeAD Marketplace
eyebrow: SYSTEM CASE STUDY · CLASSIFIEDS / AI AUTOMATION
subtitle: A connected marketplace, from the first listing to the last human handoff.
summary: Multi-country classifieds with dynamic listings, location search, messaging, seller storefronts, payments, AI-assisted support and administration.
overview: A source-reviewed look inside a multi-country classifieds ecosystem: flexible publishing, geo-aware discovery, direct buyer–seller conversations, monetization, moderation and an AI-to-human customer support path.
focus: The engineering story is about connecting marketplace complexity into workflows people can use—not claiming unverified production metrics.
caveat: This page reflects an uploaded source inventory at a pinned commit, not an independent production audit. Specific individual code contributions and live deployment outcomes require confirmation.

highlights.title: Marketplace engine
highlights.body: Publish and moderate classified ads, custom category fields, shop profiles and location-specific discovery.

highlights.title: AI + human support
highlights.body: AI first-response eligibility, confusion detection, agent queues and human escalation paths.

highlights.title: Commercial layer
highlights.body: Packages, listing boosts, PayPal subscription code and a tracked webhook/audit workflow.

highlights.title: Back-office control
highlights.body: KYC review, roles, permissions, content management, analytics screens and operational tools.
